greeting: Egameni likaYise, neleNdodana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube nani uxolo nothando lukaKristu oluhlala luninzi ezintliziyweni zethu.
penitential: Nkosi, beka inceba. Kristu, beka inceba. Nkosi, beka inceba.
psalm_response: Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba.
homily:
Kukho imizuzu apho ubomi bujongeka njengendawo engenanto, apho ukuthula kwendlu kunzima ukukuthwala. Mhlawumbi uke wema ecaleni kwesango okanye kwibala leenqwelo-moya, ubukele iindiza zisuka, ucinga ngaloo mntu uphakathi kwethu owayekuthanda ukubukela iinjini neempiko zazo zinyuka ziye esibhakabhakeni. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo thando. Wayengumfana owayejonga phezulu, engajongi nje iindiza, kodwa ejonga ubukhulu bukaThixo obufihlakeleyo kwiimfihlo zenzululwazi kunye nobuchwephesha. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukucacisa ngale ‘con chim airlines’ yakhe, ebonisa ukuba intliziyo yakhe yayingeyiyo nje eyobuchwephesha, kodwa eyayizaliswe lithemba elikhulu. UBen wayeyindoda encinci eyayikwazi ukuzibona iindiza zayo zibhabha ngaphaya kwamafu, njengokuba wayesoloko ecinga ngekamva elizele luvuyo.

Namhlanje, kwiNcwadi ka-Efese, uPawulos usicela ukuba sikhangele ngamehlo entliziyo. Uthi: 'Maye amehlo eentliziyo zenu akhanyiselwe, ukuze nazi ukuba liyintoni na ithemba elibangelwa kukubizwa kwakhe.' Amehlo entliziyo. Lawo ngamehlo angaboni nje izinto eziphathekayo, kodwa abona uthando lukaThixo olufihlakeleyo kuyo yonke imeko yobomi bethu. UBen wayengumfana owayenalo olo khanya. Wayengumfana owayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu kwako konke, wayenentliziyo eyayikwazi ukubona abanye.

Khumbula lo mfanekiso: uBen, eneminyaka eli-15, efuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange encinci ukunceda umalume wakhe uWilliam. Akazange ayiphule loo ngulube, akazange ayikhuphule imali, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. Ubenayo loo ntliziyo yayikwazi ukunikela ngayo yonke into ngaphandle kokubala. Loo ntliziyo yayicocekile, ingaphili ngemithetho yobuxoki yeli hlabathi, kodwa iphila ngenceba kaThixo. UBen wayengumfana owayethanda ukunika, owayethanda ukuba nomdla kwabanye, owayesoloko enoncumo olwaluthi, 'Ndikhona, ndiyakuthanda.'

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthi: 'Gird your loins and light your lamps and be like servants who await their master’s return.' (Bhinqani izinqe zenu, nikhanyise izibane zenu, nibe njengezicaka ezilindele ukubuya kwenkosi yazo). Le ntsingiselo yokulinda ayiyiyo eyokulinda ngoloyiko, kodwa kukuhlala ulungele ukwamkela uthando oluza. UYesu uthi: 'Blessed are those servants whom the master finds vigilant on his arrival. Amen, I say to you, he will gird himself, have them recline at table, and proceed to wait on them.' (Nokuba uza kumlindo wesibini okanye wesithathu, bazukile abo bakhonzi). Mamele le nyaniso: uYesu akalindi nje ukuba sikhonze, kodwa uYesu uzimisele ukusikhonza. UBen, ngoku, usebukhoneni obo, apho uYesu emkhonza ngoxolo olungunaphakade.

Kodwa Alan, Thao, nawe Ryan mfowethu omncane, ndiyazi ukuba kule nyanga yesine emva kokuba uBen ebuyele kuThixo, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha njengomsinga ongaqondakaliyo. Kukho imibuzo eza ebusuku, kukho imizuzu apho uzibuza ukuba ngaba kukhona na eninokuze nako kwenza ngokwahlukileyo. Ndifuna ukuba uphulaphule inyaniso kaThixo namhlanje, kwaye uyivumele ingene nzulu entliziyweni yakho: akukho nqaku lokuthi uphosile okanye wenze kakubi. Ukugula akwanga kwenzeka ngenxa yezinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. UThixo akakubeki icala, kwaye noBen akakubeki icala kwaphela. Masikhuphe lo mthwalo wokuzisola emajukujukwini eentliziyo zenu namhlanje. Awuphosanga nto. Ubenze konke okusemandleni enu ngothando olungapheliyo. Ezinye izinto kulo mhlaba zenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lwethu, ngaphandle kokuba nabani na enze impazamo. Niyinyaniso, nithandwa nguThixo ngokupheleleyo.

UYesu uthi: 'Musa ukoyika.' Lo ngumyalelo, kodwa ikwangulwazi oluphilisayo. UBen akalahlekanga. Usemkhono kaThixo, apho akukho ntlungu, apho akukho zifo, apho kukho kuphela uthando olungenasiphelo. UBen ukhangele phantsi kuwe Ryan, kwaye akakushiye. Xa udlala okanye ucinga ngekamva, yazi ukuba uBen ukuthembile, ukuthandile, kwaye usakuthanda kakhulu. UBen usengumntwana ononcumo, usengumntwana ocinga ngekamva, usengumntwana okhathalayo.

Namhlanje, masithathe oku: uBen wayengumfana owafunda ukunika. Masifunde nathi ukunika—ukunika iintlungu zethu kuThixo, ukunika ithemba lethu kuye, kwaye ukunika uthando lwethu kwabo basijikelezileyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into.

Kukho amandla amakhulu ekuncedeni abanye. Njengokuba uBen wayenalo olo nqweno lokunika, kwaye njengokuba umsebenzi wamanzi acocekileyo eCà Mau uqhubeka ukhumbuza ihlabathi ngobubele bakhe, nani qhubekani niphila ngaloo ndlela. Niphilele uRyan, niphilele ukukhanya, niphilele ukuba uBen wayengumfana owafundisa ihlabathi ukuba uthando lukhulu kunako konke. Hamba ke namhlanje ukhululekile emthwalweni wokuzisola. Bamba isandla sikaYesu, uthembe ukuba uYisease usezintliziyweni zenu, kwaye uBen ulala ngokuthula ekhanyeni likaThixo, esikhangela sonke ngovuyo olungunaphakade. Amen.
petitions: Sikhulela uBen nabo bonke abashiyileyo, ukuze baphumle ngokuthula ekukhanyeni kukaKristu, sithandaze eNkosini.
Sikhulela bonke abakhalayo, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele kwaye abaphe ithemba elingenasiphelo, sithandaze eNkosini.
spiritual_communion: Nkosi yam uYesu, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona kwiSakramente eliNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwako konke, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Njengoko ndingenako ngoku ukukwamkela ngendlela ecacileyo, nceda uze kum ngomoya wothando. Ndiyakwamkela njengokuba sele ukhona, kwaye ndizinikela kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndohlukane nawe. Amen.
closing: Makube nani usikelelo lukaThixo uSomandla, uYise, neNdodana, noMoya oyiNgcwele. Hambani ngokuthula.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Bazalwane: Anisengabafokazi nabahenqi, kodwa ningabemi kunye nabangcwele, ningamalungu endlu kaThixo, eyakhiwe phezu kwesiseko sabapostile nabaprofeti, uKristu Yesu ngokwakhe enguye ilitye legumbi. Ngaye isakhiwo sonke sibambene, sikhula sibe yitempile engcwele eNkosini; kuye nani nakhiwa kunye nibe yindawo yokuhlala kaThixo eMoyeni.

readings.label: Indumiso
readings.text: R. Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba. Amazulu abhengeza ubuqaqawuli bukaThixo, isibhakabhaka sibhengeza umsebenzi wezandla zakhe. Imini iphalaza ilizwi emini, ubusuku bubonisa ulwazi ebusuku. R. Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba. Akukho lizwi, akukho ntetho, engavakalisi izwi layo. Ilizwi labo lihamba emhlabeni wonke, imiyalezo yabo ifikelela eziphelweni zelizwe. R. Amazwi abo avakala kuwo wonke umhlaba.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wenyuka waya entabeni ukuyokuthandaza, wachitha ubusuku bonke ethandaza kuThixo. Kwathi kusa, wabiza abafundi bakhe, wanyula kubo abalishumi elinambini, ababiza ngokuba ngabapostile: uSimon, amnika igama elinguPetros, noAndreya umninawa wakhe, uJakobe, uYohane, uFilipu, uBhartolomeyu, uMateyu, uTomas, uJakobe unyana ka-Alifeyu, uSimon obizwa ngokuba ngumZeloti, uYuda unyana kaJakobe, noYuda Iskariyoti, owathi waba ngumngcatshi.

day: Feast of Saints Simon and Jude, Apostles

pet_prayers.text: Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Today marks 100 days without you. Miss you a whole a lot Ben. Feel free to visit any time! See you around buddy! Love you!

Ben ơi, nay anh M đi xử lý hồ sơ ở Cam Ranh, đi ngang qua Cam Ranh Airport. Rồi cuộc nói chuyện về máy bay của Ben lại ùa về, nhớ nhiều kỷ niệm về Ben lắm ( anh M sẽ giữ kín kakaka). Quỷ nhỏ, tự nhiên nghĩ về mày buồn dễ sợ. Hãy đi đến những nơi mà Ben muốn nha và đừng quên là luôn nhớ về gia đình mình nhé, thương em trai nhiều. Giá như !!!!!!!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: What happened my son? It's been 3 months since you left us. Missing you so much my whole body aches. Mom cries every day now... What are we going to do now Ben?  Please pray for us.
